column1: #   concept          - unique concept word (creates a node in the graph)
#   n_motor_steps    - number of motor nodes to wire into the chain
#   requires_precond - 1 = motor chain has EDGE_REQUIRES to a precondition node
#   precond_active   - 1 = precondition node is activated (>= threshold)
#                      0 = precondition node is NOT activated (below threshold)
#   expected_veto    - 1 = ShadowBrain must veto; 0 = ShadowBrain must allow
#   safe always:        requires_precond=0 (no gate) OR precond_active=1 (gate met)
